 • Part Number: 211TTW9002 (also referenced as RayTools RF Sensor Cable / TTW Line).

Advanced Electromagnetic Shielding and Signal Integrity 
This premium encoder cable features a multi-core, high-density braided shield that eliminates signal cross-talk and external electromagnetic noise. It prevents axis positioning errors and sudden autofocus calibration drift during demanding, heavy-duty industrial laser cutting operations.

Its internal structural flexibility allows it to withstand millions of continuous bending cycles inside the machine's cable carrier tracks without conductor fatigue.

offer.name: Focus Lens, Fused Silica plano-convex spherical lens, 20,150, 3kW
offer.description:
Premium Laser Welding Focusing Lens 3250010444 
This biconvex focusing lens is a high-precision optical component engineered specifically for fiber laser welding and hand-held welding systems. Tailored to meet the demanding requirements of high-power density applications, this lens guarantees perfect focal alignment and exceptional transmission performance during intense industrial operations. 
Key Technical Specifications 
Part Number: 3250010444 Type: Biconvex Focusing Lens Diameter (D): 20 mm Focal Length (F): 150 mm Center Thickness (CT): 4.5 mm Substrate Material: Corning HPFS 7980 Fused Silica Supported Laser Power: Up to 2000W (2kW) 
 
High-Grade Corning Fused Silica and AR Coating 
Crafted from premium Corning HPFS 7980 fused silica, this optical lens possesses an incredibly low thermal expansion coefficient and high resistance to thermal shock. Both surfaces are treated with an advanced double-sided anti-reflective coating (AR/AR @ 1064 nm), reducing energy loss from reflection to less than 0.2%, maximizing laser power transmission, and preventing thermal lensing effects. 
 
Engineered for Extreme Industrial Conditions 
Handheld laser welding creates significant amounts of heat, micro-spatter, and dust. The 3250010444 lens is manufactured with a hardened coating layer that resists surface scratches and dust adhesion, extending its overall service life and protecting the deeper fiber laser system mechanics from optical feedback damage. 
 
Broad Compatibility with RayTools Systems 
As an authentic replacement component, the 3250010444 lens perfectly integrates with the optical assembly of the RayTools BW101-GS laser welding torch series. Its absolute dimensional precision (20mm diameter and 4.5mm edge thickness) ensures seamless fitment inside the lens holder, eliminating beam deviation and maintaining a consistent weld bead quality.

offer.name: Double layer standard nozzle 1.0mm, M14, H15, 32mm
offer.description:
Premium Double-Layer Laser Nozzle 120GJT0610 
This double-layer standard nozzle is a high-performance consumable engineered for precision fiber laser cutting applications. Featuring an integrated dual-layer internal geometry and protective outer plating, this nozzle delivers the exact aerodynamic support needed to maintain absolute beam alignment and clean edge quality. 
 
Key Technical Specifications 
Model / Part Code: 120GJT0610 Type: Double layer (Standard coned) Orifice Diameter: 1.0 mm Thread Size: M14 Height (H): 15 mm Outer Diameter: 32 mm Surface Treatment: Electrolytic Chrome Plating 
 
Engineered for High-Quality Oxygen (O₂) Cutting 
Unlike single-layer variants, double-layer laser nozzles are specialized for carbon steel, mild steel, and low-alloy steel cutting using Oxygen (O₂) as an auxiliary gas. The dual-wall construction and 1.0mm orifice optimize gas velocity, preventing turbulence and allowing the oxygen to spark a clean, controlled exothermic reaction that rapidly removes molten metal without leaving heavy dross or carbon burrs. 
 
Chromed T2 Copper Structure for Extended Lifespan 
Manufactured from premium-grade T2 copper, this nozzle offers superior electrical and thermal conductivity. The advanced chromium electroplating forms a smooth, non-stick shield on the outer shell. This prevents cutting sparks, flying slag, and molten metal spatter from adhering to the tip, ensuring stable distance tracking and a significantly longer component service life. 
Flawless Compatibility and Sensor Alignment 
With an exact 32mm base diameter, 15mm height, and standard M14 threading, the 120GJT0610 guarantees a secure, leak-free seat on the laser head. Its precise physical alignment ensures reliable capacitance height sensing data, eliminating calibration errors and avoiding costly collisions between the laser head and the metal sheet during fast production cycles.

offer.name: Locking nut BM110/BM111/BM114S
offer.description:
Original RayTools Locking Nut 120610336A 
This locking nut is an essential mechanical component engineered to secure laser nozzles and optical components within fiber laser cutting heads. Designed to withstand intense industrial vibrations, this locking nut maintains the absolute stability of your cutting setup for flawless day-to-day operations. 
 
Key Technical Specifications 
Part Number: 120610336A Type: Nozzle Locking Nut / Lock Ring Thread Type: Standard M14 compatibility Material: Premium industrial brass / copper alloy Function: Nozzle fixing and gas flow stabilization 
 
Vibration Resistance and Focal Stability 
During high-speed laser cutting, acceleration and gas pressure create constant vibrations. The 120610336A locking nut tightly clamps the nozzle in place, preventing micro-shifts that can ruin the laser beam calibration, distort the gas jet symmetry, or cause expensive cutting defects. 
 
Premium Material Construction 
Manufactured from high-quality alloy with excellent thermal resistance, this locking nut does not deform under the high temperatures generated near the cutting zone. The durable threads resist cross-threading and stripping, ensuring a long service life even with frequent nozzle changes. 
 
Seamless Integration and Compatibility 
As an original RayTools component, the 120610336A provides perfect thread tolerance and mechanical alignment. It ensures an airtight seal for auxiliary gases and maintains the precise distance needed for the laser head’s height tracking and capacitance sensors to operate without errors.

offer.name: XC6000 EtherCAT Motion Control System
offer.description:
Price on request. Contact MD Power Machines for a quote: +971 52 220 7761, info@mdpower-machines.com. The XC6000 EtherCAT motion control system is a high-performance industrial CNC solution engineered to drive and regulate advanced multi-axis fiber laser cutting and welding machinery. Designed to coordinate complex automation tasks, this master-level control system utilizes ultra-fast EtherCAT bus communication to ensure the structural integrity of real-time machine movements, laser power modulation, and high-speed automated autofocus execution. Built for demanding smart factory environments, the XC6000 delivers zero-backlash positioning and closed-loop accuracy across complex production cycles. 
 
 
Key Specifications: 
 
 • 
 
 • Product: Industrial CNC Motion Control System 
 • Model / Series: RayTools XC6000 Series 
 • Bus Technology: EtherCAT (Ethernet for Control Automation Technology) 
 • Control Axes: Multi-axis synchronization (Supports specialized X/Y/Z profiling and rotary axis) 
 • Focal Distance Tracking: Integrated real-time closed-loop capacitance tracking loop interface 
 • Application: High-power flat sheet metal cutting, automated tube profiling, and robotic laser welding systems 
 
 
 
 
 
Features: 
 
 • Process database can be expanded as clients require. 
 • Fly cut, down jump, compensate, lead, micro-joint, pre-pierce, multilevel pierce and film cut etc… 
 • Auto FindEdge, manual FindEdge, auto sort and break point cut, etc… 
 • Cooling point and triangle cut. 
 • Auto sort: auto transferred to system recognized format, auto sorted and generate to NC or PART files. 
 • Compatible to various lasers. 
 • Compatible to processing by manual G code modification 
 • Communication: EtherCAT protocol control with real-time refresh cycle 1ms. 
 • Accuracy: path 0.005mm, positioning 0.001mm, repeated positioning 0.002mm. 
 • Speed: max. acceleration 3G, max. dry motion 250m/min. 
 • Safety: overload protection to axis moment, real-time monitoring to axis moment to stop and upload servo alarm. 
 • FindEdge: Auto FindEdge and manual FindEdge (Auto FindEdge can turn angle automatically by detecting slight angle deviation of metal material). 
 • Alarm: alarm log export to give reference to operator. 
 • Friendly maintenance: auto calibration and break point mode. 
 • Commissioning: close-loop arc detection feature to save commissioning time. Torque monitoring feature to detect the status of mechanical meshing if it is too tight or loose.

offer.name: XC3000T EtherCAT Motion Control System
offer.description:
Price on request. Contact MD Power Machines for a quote: +971 52 220 7761, info@mdpower-machines.com. The XC3000T EtherCAT motion control system is a versatile, dual-purpose industrial CNC solution engineered specifically to drive and regulate automated combo fiber laser machines that process both flat sheets and rotary tubes. Designed to handle hybrid production lines, this control system utilizes ultra-fast EtherCAT bus communication to ensure the structural integrity of real-time machine movements, laser power modulation, and high-speed automated autofocus execution. Built to eliminate the need for separate controllers, the XC3000T delivers seamless software switching, zero-backlash multi-axis synchronization, and reliable closed-loop accuracy across demanding manufacturing cycles.. 
 
 
 
Key Specifications: 
 
 • Product: Industrial Combo CNC Motion Control System 
 • Model / Series: RayTools XC3000T Series 
 • Bus Technology: EtherCAT (Ethernet for Control Automation Technology) 
 • Control Axes: Dual-mode Multi-Axis Synchronization (Supports standard X/Y/Z tables and rotary chuck axes) 
 • Focal Distance Tracking: Integrated real-time closed-loop capacitance tracking loop interface 
 • Application: Hybrid 2D flat sheet metal profiling and multi-axis rotary tube/profile cutting systems 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Features: 
 
 • One-Click Switch functionality: Users can transition instantly between sheet cutting and tube cutting modes through the software interface, significantly reducing machine downtime and increasing operational flexibility during high-mix production runs. 
 • Multi-Material Processing: Equipped with dual-system capabilities for both flat plates and 3D workpieces, the XC3000T is optimized for diverse material handling, ensuring high-quality finishes across varying geometries. 
 • Integrated Versatility: This all-in-one solution is fully compatible with the application functions of the XC3000S and XC4000T series. This compatibility ensures a seamless transition for existing Raytools users and allows for a unified training protocol across different machine tiers. 
 • High-Precision Control: The system supports both EtherCAT and Pulse+Direction interfaces, offering flexible integration with various motor drivers while maintaining the high-speed synchronization required for intricate laser paths. 
 • Master/Slave Architecture: By leveraging a Master/Slave synergy between the IPC-E4000 HMI PC (Windows) and the EDM-3000 Engine PC (Linux), the system guarantees a responsive user experience alongside the rock-solid real-time stability of a dedicated motion control engine.

Designed to coordinate complex joint processing tasks, this control system utilizes precise signal communication to ensure the structural integrity of real-time machine movements, laser power modulation, and dynamic beam oscillation (wobble) tracking. Built to meet the rigid demands of modern industrial welding cells, the XW100 delivers reliable closed-loop accuracy, consistent pulse frequency regulation, and stable power scaling across intense production cycles. 
 
 
 
Key Specifications: 
 
 • 
 
 • Product: Industrial Laser Welding Control System. 
 • Model / Series: RayTools XW100 Series. 
 • Control Interface: Dedicated Multi-Axis Automation and IO Expansion Connectivity. 
 • Beam Regulation: Real-time laser pulse modulation and continuous frequency scaling. 
 • Tracking Modes: Integrated support for seam tracking, gap bridging, and wobble control interfaces. 
 • Application: Automated stationary laser welding, programmable wobble welding, and robotic joint processing systems. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Features: 
 
 • Kernel Platform: It is developed based on the xStudio platform, which is a kernel platform independently developed by the Raytools DT team. 
 • Real-time Stability: The system is equipped with a PREEMPT_RT real-time system, ensuring high system stability and fast responsiveness. 
 • Seamless Integration: It supports standard communication protocols like OPC UA and Modbus-TCP, facilitating seamless integration with various industrial devices. 
 • No-Code Programming: It utilizes an interactive teaching interface, allowing operators to edit welding programs through user-friendly functions (like lines and circles) without the need for code programming. 
 • Advanced Process Control: The system features 9-layer management for stratified control and corner power control, which optimizes laser energy at corners to improve weld quality.

offer.name: KW100 Laser Welding Motion Control System
offer.description:
Price on request. Contact MD Power Machines for a quote: +971 52 220 7761, info@mdpower-machines.com. This KW100 laser welding motion control system is an advanced, production-ready solution engineered specifically to drive and regulate automated fiber laser welding equipment. Designed to bridge the gap between hardware and software, this comprehensive control package combines real-time motion control with specialized welding process functions to ensure the structural integrity of complex seams. Built for industrial equipment builders and system integrators, the KW100 delivers stable energy modulation, precision synchronization, and seamless automation deployment across intense manufacturing projects. 
 
 
 
Key Specifications: 
 
 • Product: Industrial Laser Welding Control Subsystem. 
 • Model / Series: RayTools KW100 Series. 
 • Application Type: Integrated Control and Process Management. 
 • Target Equipment: Automated Welding Benches, Linear Seam Welders, and Dedicated Machine Builders. 
 • Functionality: Synchronized axis motion control combined with advanced laser process parameter gating. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Features: 
 
 • Four-Axis RTCP Control: A standout feature is the RTCP (Rotation Tool Center Point) function, which ensures the laser focus remains on the programmed trajectory during rotation and adjusts energy based on speed/position to solve laser overburning. 
 • Deep Process Coupling: It achieves high precision through the deep coupling of motion interpolation and the welding process, performing power-position matching calculations 1000 times per second. 
 • Versatile Platform Support: It offers a standard four-axis linkage + four-station EtherCAT bus control solution, which improves wiring efficiency and supports multi-station auxiliary fixture logic. 
 • Flexible Hardware Architecture: The system uses the X7S Intelligent Welding Controller, which features a fanless industrial IPC architecture running on a Linux operating system for low power consumption. 
 • Customization and Development: It supports secondary development, providing configurable interface tools and general PLC program editors to help customers protect their core technologies. 
 • Smart Component Control: It includes specialized control for swing welding heads (for large gaps) and flexible wire feeding with automatic tracking algorithms to maintain a constant wire direction.

offer.name: VBA-Visual Beam Aligne (WIFI)
offer.description:

The VBA (Visual Beam Align) WiFi module is an advanced, standalone smart calibration tool engineered to provide fast, high-precision coaxial alignment of the laser beam and the nozzle. Designed to replace traditional, error-prone manual tape-shot methods, this universal instrument utilizes AI-based vision technology and a high-precision circle-fitting algorithm to ensure the structural integrity of the optical path before cutting operations begin. Featuring wireless WiFi connectivity for instant mobile device streaming, the VBA module eliminates human error, dramatically shortens setup times, and guarantees stable, burr-free material processing. 
 
 
 
Key Specifications:

offer.name: Collimation lens assembly F100, BM111
offer.description: A premium quality collimation lens assembly engineered specifically for high-power RayTools fiber laser processing heads (primarily compatible with the BM110 and BM111 series). This complete optical module integrates high-precision lenses inside a pre-aligned mechanical holder, transforming the divergent laser beam from the fiber connector into a perfectly parallel (collimated) beam for flawless cutting and welding accuracy. \nCrafted from ultra-pure imported fused silica and treated with dual-sided, multi-layer anti-reflective (AR) coatings, the 120AG0600A assembly delivers an exceptionally high damage threshold and minimal power absorption. This superior optical engineering completely eliminates focal shift, ensuring reliable and stable performance even under continuous multi-kilowatt industrial workloads. \n

offer.name: Focus lens assembly F155, BM111
offer.description: The 120AG0800A is an OEM original, high-precision focusing lens assembly engineered specifically for RayTools professional fiber laser cutting and welding heads, primarily optimized for the widely used BM110 and BM111 series. Operating at a standard fiber laser wavelength of 1064nm, this pre-aligned optical-mechanical module is purpose-built to sustain high energy fields in industrial systems. Its critical function is to tightly converge the incoming collimated laser beam into a flawless, minimum-diameter focal point to deliver ultimate processing speeds and razor-sharp edge quality.The module consists of a premium compound lens set securely mounted within a rugged, factory-sealed precision housing sleeve. Crafted from ultra-pure imported fused silica, the optics feature an exceptionally high laser damage threshold and excellent thermal stability. Both outer surfaces are treated with advanced, multi-layer anti-reflective (AR) coatings to minimize power absorption and ensure maximum light transmission. This superior thermal engineering effectively eliminates focal shift during prolonged multi-kilowatt industrial cutting cycles.
